description:
This the worst drywall job I've seen. I paid a professional drywall crew for a Level 5 finish and it's a mess. In this video I’m fixing their cracks, peeling tape and crooked corners myself. If you found this video helpful, please subscribe. Cheers! Watch EverythingYou Need to Know About Drywall 👉🏼https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL34cQkzKfXWaL0vnQBqEkAb6VDAvqsMJC

This is the ultimate drywall repair tutorial, I’ll show you how to fix over-sanded inside corners, tape bare joints, replace failed drywall tape, straighten wavy ceiling lines and rebuild twisted outside corners. Today I'm using Muddskip, which makes this drywall repair easier and faster, so you can fix bad drywall yourself and get a smooth finish without hiring another crew.
